::: {.cgp-footer}

```{ojs}
// The notice comes from config/site.toml through meta.json: a shared prefix
// followed by one clause per chain actually present in the capture, so a reader
// is never disclaimed at about a chain this page cannot show them.
siteFooter = {
  const repo = (meta.releases && meta.releases.all
    ? meta.releases.all.replace(/\/releases.*$/, "")
    : "https://github.com/coatless-datasets/club-gas-prices");
  return html`<div>
    ${(Array.isArray(meta.notice) ? meta.notice : [meta.notice])
      .map((line) => html`<p class="cgp-footer-notice">${line}</p>`)}
    <p class="cgp-footer-notice">Represent one of these chains and want something changed or
      removed? <a href=${repo + "/issues/new"}>Open an issue</a> or write to the address in the
      <a href=${repo + "/blob/main/README.md"}>repository</a>.</p>
  </div>`;
}
```

:::
